About Smart Working 
 At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity — it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.
 Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.
 Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.
 Applicants must have the right to work in the country they are applying from and be able to work without employer sponsorship. 
 About the Role 
 As a Senior PHP/Symfony Engineer, you will take hands-on ownership of backend development within a mature Symfony platform that manages marketing and revenue data for enterprise customers. The core application currently runs on Symfony 6.1, with an upgrade to Symfony 7 planned, alongside an Angular front end and TypeScript and Python AI agent microservices. 
 This is a strongly backend-weighted, senior hands-on engineering role requiring an architect mindset, strong independence and the ability to understand how technical decisions affect the wider system. You will work within a remote, cross-functional product squad alongside engineering, product, QA and DevOps colleagues.
 Responsibilities 
Take ownership of backend development within the core Symfony application, becoming fully independent in delivering work within 2–3 months of joining
Review and critically assess code written by the team and AI tools, challenging proposed approaches and making sure key considerations have been properly addressed
Support the migration from Symfony 6.1 to Symfony 7 by resolving versioning, compatibility and legacy issues currently preventing the upgrade
Improve the application’s performance, scalability and maintainability, making it easier and safer to introduce new functionality
Work across the Angular front end, TypeScript and Python-based AI agent services, collaborating with DevOps where backend changes impact other areas of the system
Be comfortable reading and understanding the Angular/TypeScript codebase, even though the role is primarily backend focused. Strong front-end development experience is not required
Understand the wider impact of technical decisions across Symfony, Angular and AI services, while spotting gaps or issues in both human-written and AI-generated code
Question existing approaches, identify root causes and look for better ways of building things rather than simply completing assigned tickets
Deliver thoughtful, maintainable solutions within a legacy codebase while maintaining a consistent pace of delivery
Work with a high level of autonomy and ownership while collaborating effectively with a remote, cross-functional team
Follow SOC 2, PII and security requirements consistently and without exception
 Requirements 
8+ years of commercial software engineering experience, including at least 5 years working with PHP
7+ years of Expert-level PHP development experience
3+ years of recent commercial experience with Symfony 6.x/7 at Advanced level. Strong senior-level Laravel experience may be considered where the experience is clearly transferable and the candidate has a good understanding of the differences between Laravel and Symfony
4+ years of Advanced experience in backend architecture, system design and scalability
2+ years of Advanced experience using AI development tools critically, including reviewing, validating and challenging AI-generated code rather than accepting it without question
5+ years of Advanced MySQL experience, including database schema design and query optimisation. Equivalent depth of experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database may also be considered
At least 1 year of experience working with or understanding Angular/TypeScript. Experience with React or Vue using TypeScript may also be considered, but some front-end exposure is essential
3+ years of Advanced experience with automated testing using PHPUnit. Experience with Pest or another equivalent PHP testing framework may also be considered
At least 1 year of Intermediate experience working on framework upgrades and modernising legacy codebases. Experience with major-version upgrades or significant refactoring in other large PHP applications may be considered
2+ years of Intermediate AWS experience. Equivalent experience with Azure or GCP may also be considered
Fluent written and spoken English
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to work effectively in a remote environment
Ability to work UK hours
Ability to successfully complete strict background checks and adhere to PII and data protection requirements
Strong self-sufficiency, with the ability to operate independently and without handholding after 2–3 months, while continuing to collaborate effectively with the wider team
A hands-on engineering approach combined with an architectural mindset, with the ability to understand how and why the wider system works rather than focusing only on writing code
 Nice to Have 
2+ years of Intermediate CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions; GitLab CI, Jenkins or Azure DevOps are suitable alternatives
Basic experience with Amazon Redshift or data warehousing; Snowflake or BigQuery may be considered. 
Azure exposure alongside AWS
Previous project leadership experience
Previous mentoring and technical leadership experience with other engineers
